description: Two-dimensional n-channel MOSFET (quantities per unit width) with resolved n+ source and drain wells

geometry.coordinates: x along the channel, source side first; y = depth into silicon, y = 0 at the Si/SiO2 interface, oxide at -t_ox <= y <= 0

doping.profile: uniform acceptors N_A plus donors N_D(x, y) = 1e20 f_x(x) f_y(y), with f_x = 0.5 erfc((x - x_c)/(sqrt(2) sigma)) + 0.5 erfc(((L - x) - x_c)/(sqrt(2) sigma)), x_c = -sqrt(2) sigma erfcinv(2 N_A / 1e20) (so N_D = N_A at x = 0 and x = L), f_y = 0.5 erfc((y - h_w)/(sqrt(2) sigma_y))

physics.holes: held at equilibrium, p = n_i exp(-psi/V_T) (not a solution variable)
physics.psi_reference: intrinsic level (psi = 0 where n = p = n_i)

contacts.gate: oxide top y = -t_ox over 0 <= x <= L: psi = V_G + psi_b0 (flat-band voltage 0)
contacts.source: silicon edge x = -0.3 um, 0 <= y <= contact depth: psi = V_T asinh(N_net/(2 n_i)), n = n_i exp(psi/V_T)
contacts.drain: silicon edge x = L + 0.3 um, 0 <= y <= contact depth: psi = V_T asinh(N_net/(2 n_i)) + V_D, n = n_i exp((psi - V_D)/V_T); driven by the circuit voltage source V1
contacts.body: silicon bottom y = 1.2 um, full width: psi = psi_b0, n = n_i exp(psi_b0/V_T)
contacts.other_boundaries: zero normal electric displacement and zero normal electron current
contacts.oxide_corners: the two Si/SiO2 corner nodes at the far silicon edges are tied to the adjacent source/drain contact potential

mesh.note: fixed tensor-product mesh; each rectangle is split into two triangles

units: cm, V, cm^-3; currents in A/cm and conductances in S/cm (per cm of device width)
